data.desc: Headquartered in Hong Kong, the Company is a multi-disciplinary corporate service provider with a strong presence in Hong Kong and Singapore. Through its wholly-owned operating subsidiaries in Hong Kong and Singapore, the Company specializes in offering corporate secretarial services, accounting services, intellectual properties registration services in Hong Kong and Singapore, under the 'Accolade' brand. The Company's clientele ranges from individual clients, small and medium-sized enterprises to multinational corporations, reflecting its ability to cater to diverse business needs with tailored, technology enhanced solutions.
